item.name: Baju Kurung Set - Round Neck Long Sleeve Blouse with Printed Cuffs & Matching Big Flower Skirt - Elegant Modest Women's Raya Outfit
item.title: Baju Kurung Set - Round Neck Long Sleeve Blouse with Printed Cuffs & Matching Big Flower Skirt - Elegant Modest Women's Raya Outfit
item.description:
This 2026 baju kurung two-piece set stands out with striking large floral placement design. Lush blooming flowers are precisely positioned at the neckline and cuffs of the blouse, while the matching midi skirt features coordinated big-flower print all over. It creates an elegant symmetrical visual effect, blending dignified festive temperament with daily wearability. Perfect for Hari Raya celebrations, family visits, social gatherings and semi-formal occasions in Malaysia.

#### ✨ Eye-Catching Neck & Cuff Placement Floral Print

Exquisite large blooming floral patterns are neatly arranged along the blouse neckline and cuffs, forming a framed decorative effect that flatters the face and wrist lines. The matching skirt continues the same floral theme with full large-flower print, echoing the top for a cohesive polished look. Rich flower layers deliver a grand festive vibe, more distinctive than ordinary all-over small prints.

#### ✨ Dignified Round-Neck Straight Silhouette

Classic round neck design presents a modest and gentle look. Long sleeves provide full coverage for modest dressing, with comfortable room for arm movement. Straight-cut midi skirt flatters the lower body with smooth lines, allowing free movement while maintaining an elegant and poised posture all day long.

#### 💨 Smooth Draping Fabric For Tropical Climate

Made of lightweight draping fabric with soft handfeel. Excellent breathability keeps you cool and comfortable in Malaysia’s hot humid weather. The fabric resists wrinkling well, keeping a neat and refined appearance from morning visits to evening festive events.

#### 🧵 High-Definition Sublimation Print & Fine Workmanship

Advanced heat-sublimation printing restores vivid flower colours and delicate petal details. The print stays bright and resists fading after repeated washes. Precise stitching at the neckline, cuffs and skirt hem ensures durability and a clean high-quality finish.

#### 🎯 Versatile For Festive & Daily Occasions

Ideal for Hari Raya Aidilfitri, visiting relatives and friends, family banquets, casual social events and light formal occasions. Wear as a set for a complete elegant festive look, or style the blouse and skirt separately with other pieces to create more daily outfit ideas.

#### 💫 2026 Elegant Big-Flower Modest Fashion Staple

Combines statement large floral design with classic baju kurung silhouette, balancing grand festive charm and everyday practicality. It is a stylish must-have piece to elevate your 2026 modest wardrobe.
